descriptionChirho: Describing something as being in a lower position relative to something else, used attributively or predicatively (e.g., lower chambers, lower millstone).
Substantival use referring to the lowest regions of the earth, the underworld, or Sheol, often in the plural construct 'lowest parts of the earth' (תַּחְתִּיּוֹת הָאָרֶץ).
The physical bottom or base of a geographic feature such as a mountain, used with a locative preposition to indicate position at the foot or base.
